Characters chosen so the input spans below, at, and above the boundary 'F' (U+0046). 'A'=U+0041, 'D'=U+0044, 'F'=U+0046, 'G'=U+0047, 'Z'=U+005A
above('F') escapes every code point strictly greater than 'F' (exclusive boundary). 'A', 'D', 'F' stay literal; 'G' and 'Z' are above 'F', so they are escaped.
below('F') escapes every code point strictly less than 'F' (exclusive boundary). 'A' and 'D' are below 'F', so they are escaped; 'F', 'G', 'Z' stay literal.

between('F', 'L') escapes every code point in the inclusive range ['F'..'L']. 'A' and 'D' are below the range and 'Z' is above it, so they stay literal; 'F' and 'G' fall within ['F'..'L'], so they are escaped.
